title: Python independent targeted-message receiver/generator
description: Independent implementation from draft text only (no OpenMLS source). pyca/cryptography; hand-written RFC 9180 HPKE validated against official RFC 9180 vectors; MLS primitives validated against mls-implementations vectors. Verifies OpenMLS vectors (accept valid, reject invalid at expected step) and generates a few positive vectors for OpenMLS to verify.
notes: Python independent impl in ~/PROJECT/targeted-vectors/python/ (hpke.py, mls.py, verify.py, generate.py, test_oracles.py, draft-vectors.json). Oracle tests OK: RFC9180 A.1.1/A.1.2/A.2.1/A.2.2/A.3.1/A.3.2 (all setup values + every listed encryption), mls-implementations crypto-basics/key-schedule exporter/deserialization/tree-validation leaf sigs, suites 1-3. Draft appendix vectors 1-3 PASS. python-vectors.json: 54 vectors (per suite 8 valid + 10 invalid: decode x2, group_id, epoch, recipient_leaf_index, sender_data, sender_leaf_index, signature, ciphertext, padding); verify.py 54/54. Interpretations: self-addressed sender index rejected as sender_leaf_index; TargetedMessageContent decode failure mapped to padding; strict TLS decode (trailing bytes, non-minimal varint = decode / sender_data); wrong MLSMessage version = decode; X25519 all-zero DH rejected -> ciphertext; exporter label in key-schedule.json is string bytes.
close_reason: Cross-validated 2026-11-02: Python verifies 60/60 OpenMLS (-02, base b68a50a36) vectors; OpenMLS verifies 54/54 Python vectors; both compare failure step. Outputs in ~/PROJECT/targeted-vectors/.
